content: Dad, what are we doing tonight for fun?
We're going over to Mrs. Smith's place to help her with her yard work.
Yard work? I said'what are we doing for fun', not work!
It will be fun. And besides, you'll be in the best company.
Dad. You're so cute. What do I need to do to help get ready?
You could get the rakes and some shovels together and I'll put them in the car.
Jeans and a tee shirt, right?
Yes and maybe a jacket in case it gets cool.
